en.description: Turn a user-supplied fund quarterly report highlight sheet and authorized stills into one fund quarterly report talking clip per still. This fund quarterly report talking video studio writes a speakable report-fact talking clip for each photo, then animates a 2 to 15s quarterly highlight talking clip. Use it for fund quarterly report talking packs that stay one photo, one clip.
